integrity: Two standalone deterministic verifiers using independently implemented GF(4) arithmetic reproduce the complete 21-bit census and one-/two-exchange metrics.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact computational classification on PG(2,4); static minimum and three geometric types predate this work. This contribution is the optimum exchange graph and the sharp two-point threshold. No all-order claim or independent validation; historical priority not fully certified. Source date 2003-12-11 is an identifiable public catalog creation date, not proof of the first online posting.
title: Frozen Hermitian complements and sharp two-point exchanges in \(\operatorname{PG}(2,4)\)
